content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Gumroad payhip

Gumroad and Payhip are popular choices for creators looking to sell digital products, but their limitations are stark. Gumroad offers a simple interface and basic payment processing, but it restricts access in numerous countries, limiting its usability for many creators. Payhip provides similar features but has an equally restrictive reach and often ties users to ongoing fees. In contrast, solutions like COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack empower creators with full control over their sales process without reliance on third-party platforms. This sovereignty not only ensures reliability but also allows for the integration of multiple payment methods, including cryptocurrencies, providing a more adaptable solution.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Both Gumroad and Payhip fail to cater to creators in restricted countries due to their reliance on traditional banking systems, which often exclude many regions. Stripe operates in only 46 out of 195 countries, translating to a significant percentage of the global population being ineligible to use its services. PayPal’s often opaque policies can lead to account suspensions without recourse, leaving creators in limbo for up to 180 days. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure like COREMERCH provides a structural alternative, allowing creators in these restricted areas to bypass these limitations entirely. With a self-hosted solution, the reliance on conventional payment gateways is eliminated, ensuring that access to your own revenue stream is not dictated by arbitrary restrictions.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When considering payment processing, the fees and speed of transactions are crucial. Both Gumroad and Payhip charge fees that can accumulate quickly, especially for creators with growing sales. Additionally, payment transfers can be delayed, impacting cash flow. On the other hand, using a solution like NOWPayments within the COREMERCH infrastructure allows for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification at a minimal fee of 0.5% and instant payment confirmations. This means that creators can enjoy faster access to their funds without the burden of high transaction costs, making it a more efficient option for operating a digital store.
True ownership of your digital products is a game changer.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

One of the most significant issues with platforms like Gumroad and Payhip is that they maintain ownership over your products and customer data. This dependency can lead to problems if the platform changes its policies or goes offline. In contrast, with the Edge Commerce Stack from COREMERCH, creators own everything post-deployment. The infrastructure is designed to automate payment processing and product delivery without ongoing platform dependency. This means your data and your products remain yours, securely stored and accessible, allowing for true operational sovereignty.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing the right infrastructure depends on your specific needs as a digital creator. If you are located in a region where traditional platforms like Stripe and PayPal are unavailable, the COREMERCH Edge Commerce Stack is designed for you. It is quick to deploy, robust, and allows seamless integration of multiple cryptocurrencies. This setup ensures you are not only compliant with available options but also empowered to scale your business without the limitations imposed by conventional platforms. Opting for a sovereign commerce solution is not merely an alternative; it's a strategic choice for long-term sustainability.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

If Stripe is not available in your country, you can explore alternatives like the COREMERCH Edge Commerce Stack. This infrastructure allows for automatic crypto payment processing and full ownership of your data. This approach eliminates reliance on traditional payment platforms, providing a more secure and efficient way to sell your digital products.
No more waiting on payment approvals or account verifications.

The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete deployment: Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase plus NOWPayments, deployed in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, 30-day support included. If you want to build it yourself, the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents both Stack 01 and Stack 02 in complete detail with full source code. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.
